finalText:
**Migrated 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All 36 call sites converted. `node --check` passes on every file.

Two calls stay on `db.query` in `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)`. Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it.

I left `cache.query` alone. That is the cache API, not `db`.

Next: ask the vendor to ship `db.execute`, or wrap the adapter.
